property_summary: For any fuzzed actor and any timestamp t greater than the current block number, calling fallback at time t must consume the 'once per timestamp' guard so that an immediately repeated call at the same time t reverts (pastBlockTime = t+1 > t); the mutant stores block.number, which is < t, so the repeat call succeeds and breaks the rule.
change_summary: Assign block.number instead of block.timestamp + 1 to pastBlockTime, changing the value observable via pastBlockTime().
